headline: NCT's MARK drops new album 'WINDMILL' Dec 4
sub: 12 tracks, led by 'What's your dream?', 'Don't have one'
source: Source: Upper Room via Korean media
caption:
MARK is releasing his new studio album 'WINDMILL' on Dec 4!

His label Upper Room revealed the 12-song tracklist at midnight KST on Nov 23. The title track is 'What's your dream?', 'Don't have one', and the album also includes the pre-released singles 'Happiest' and 'My Friend'.

📌 Source: Upper Room, via Korean media (Sports Kyunghyang, Star News)
